releases.name: LinBox Bionic Box64 v0.4.4 (aarch64)
releases.body:
LinBox bionic rootfs 专用 Box64（aarch64 / NDK bionic 链接 / -DANDROID=ON / ARM_DYNAREC）

- bionic ELF（PT_INTERP=/system/bin/linker64），与 rootfs 内
  wine / mesa / pulseaudio 等二进制同链同形态；box64 本体零
  glibc 依赖
- 完整安装集（不再只有单个 box64 执行文件）：
  `usr/local/bin/box64` + `usr/bin/box64` PATH 入口链接
  + `usr/lib/box64-x86_64-linux-gnu/libc++_shared.so`
  （上游 ANDROID 模式配套，被仿真 x86_64 程序的 C++ 标准库）
  + `usr/etc/box64.box64rc`（系统级调优开关）
  + `usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/`（`ld-linux-aarch64.so.1`
  私有加载器与 aarch64 glibc 运行库 —— glibc 形态 box64
  与 rootfs 内 glibc 二进制的运行层）
  + `usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/`（被仿真 x86_64 程序的
  glibc 运行库，box64 经 BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH 查找）
- 手动安装: 解包 `linbox-box64-*.tar.gz` 至 /（data/data/com.linbox/...
  自动就位），或 `linbox-container install-box64 <tar.gz|URL>`
- 安装后 linbox-container 自动探测 /usr/local/bin/box64
- 用途: 在 aarch64 设备上运行 x86_64 Wine（backend=box64）；
  v0.4.4 为 hangover-11.16 官方配套版本（错配可致 wineboot SEH 级联崩溃）
- 注意: 与完整 rootfs 包（build-bionic-rootfs）同源 —— rootfs 已内置
  同款 box64 与配套文件，单独升级时才需要本包

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.4.2
releases.body:
## What's new

### Android: an in-game menu
- In the game, press **Back three times** quickly (or **Guide** on a controller) to open the pause menu. The game pauses while it is open.
- The menu has:
  - **Resume**
  - **Frame rate**: takes effect after a restart, and the menu says so.
  - **Touch controls**: Off / Default / Always. Changes apply right away and are saved.
  - **Report a bug**
  - **Quit to launcher**: asks you to confirm first.
- Use it with touch or a controller: A selects; B, Back, Start or Guide close it.

### Launchers in your language
- The PC and phone launchers now come in English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese, following the system language.
- On PC, set `B3_LANG=en`, `zh` or `ja` to choose one yourself.

### Phone: add the app to game mode
- Some phones keep CPU clocks low for apps that are not on the system's game list. The launcher now shows a gold card asking you to add the app to the phone's game mode or game center; otherwise the game may not run at full speed.
- Tap **Done, hide this** once you've added it.
- A line under **START** reminds you how to open the in-game menu.

### Not yet tested on a device
- **Tested on a phone:** triple Back.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.4.1
releases.body:
A fix for a crash after saving.

## Fixes

- **`FATAL: ipc: unimplemented service 'pl:u'` after a save (#12).** On some screens the game asks for the list of system fonts in order of priority. That request went to a system service we don't have, and the game stopped. The fonts it gets are the same ones the game already uses everywhere else, so text is unchanged. Thanks to the reporter in #12 for the log!

## Verified

- The game builds and starts on Windows, and the font request is now answered by the runtime instead of the missing service.
- The screen that makes the request wasn't reached in our own test, so please tell us in #12 if it still happens.

## Coming from v0.4.0

- **Desktop:** unpack over the old folder and choose **Rebuild** in the launcher. Saves and settings stay.
- **Android:** install the new APK over the old one, then **SET UP** again (or **Send to my phone** from a computer that has the game). Saves and game files stay, in Internal storage or on the SD card, wherever you chose.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.4.0
releases.body:
The Android app can now keep the game on an SD card.

## New

- **Game folder on an SD card (Android, experimental).** Settings has a new **Game folder** row: choose Internal storage or an inserted SD card (or USB drive). Suggested in #12.
  - **Not set up yet:** choose the card first and put your dump on it (`Bayonetta 3/dump`, Download or Documents on the card). **SET UP** then puts the game there. The setup looks on the chosen storage first. A dump on the other storage also works, but it is copied, so it needs as much free space again. The free-space check counts that.
  - **Already set up:** choosing the card offers to **move** the game there: game data, saves, settings and shader cache. Everything is copied first, and the old folder is removed only after every file has arrived. If the move stops halfway, the game stays where it was.
  - **A card that already holds the game** is used as it is.
  - The built game itself stays in the app's private storage, so the SD card only needs to hold data. Use an exFAT card: FAT32 can't hold files of 4 GB or more.
  - **Send to my phone** now copies the game into the folder chosen in the app.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.17
releases.body:
Know before you set up: the app and the launchers now check whether your device can run the game.

## New

- **A minimum spec, checked for you.** Below it, setting up takes 30 to 60 minutes and can end in a black screen, so the app and launchers now say so first. Below the minimum they stop by default and explain why, with a choice to try anyway. If a device only falls short of the recommended spec, you get a warning.
  - **Android:** the app checks when it opens and again before **SET UP** or **START**. Minimum: Vulkan 1.3, a CPU core at 2.4 GHz or faster, 6 GB of memory, and an Adreno 640 / Mali-G68 class GPU or newer. Older Mali GPUs (G31 to G76), Mali-T, PowerVR and Maleoon are below it. Recommended: Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 or newer with 8 GB.
  - **Send to my phone** checks the phone before it builds anything, and asks before sending to a phone below the minimum (`b3_win.py phone --anyway` on the command line).

releases.name: GTA Stories Recompiled 0.3.2
releases.body:
GTA Stories Recompiled 0.3.2

Fixes
- LCS: every weapon shot at the same spot in free aim (#6). Fixed in the app; your game library keeps working. Android and PC.
- Black picture on the phone's own graphics driver (seen on an Adreno 840): the driver refused the game's draw steps. Fixed there; other Adreno phones may have had the same problem. Not tested on other phones.
- Black bar at the bottom with 3-button navigation (#1): the game now draws edge to edge. Only gesture navigation was tested here; please report if the bar is still there.
- Mali GPUs failed to start (no dual-source blending): there is now a fallback. Untested, no Mali phone here.

New

- Saves > Back up all saves and Restore a backup. Saves live only inside the app: uninstalling it or clearing its data deletes them, so back up before updating.
- Settings shows the size of each data folder and the free space (#3). The game library cannot move to external storage.

releases.body:
This release features many experimental/WIP Android improvements by @kleidis that you can test before they eventually get merged into [Azahar](https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar). It also brings up various third-party dependencies to their latest major versions, and includes some very minor bug fixes.

There is also [a beta release](https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/releases/tag/v2025.01.23-sdl-compat) that is the same as this one except that it incorporates the use of SDL3 via the SDL2 compatability layer. The intent is to port this project over to pure SDL3 eventually, but the compatability layer approach allows people to play around with things while waiting for the porting to be completed. This also gives this project a fallback in case SDL2 stops being supported upstream but new functionality such as gamepad support for new game controllers continues to be updated on the SDL3 branch.

### What's Changed
* Android: Some minor fixes by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/293
* renderer_opengl: Enable a couple of optimizations by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/294

# FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE · Android 原生移植版 v1.1.0 发布说明

- **版本号**：`v1.1.0`（`versionCode=80`，`org.ffrs.gamewindow`）
- **通用安装包**：`FFRS-1.1.0-universal.apk`（`arm64-v8a`，全平台通用）

---

## 本版本主要更新

### 1. 通用性能优化（骁龙 / 天玑全平台适用）
- **描述符与同步热路径优化**：新增图形 `PushMemo` 负载缓存、`PushMemoTexel` 原地刷新与 `SlotSets` 惰性分配，大幅降低重复描述符构建开销；扩大 `push_memo_map` 容量上限至 `32768`，避免复杂大场景频繁整表清空。
- **瞬态着色器自适应旁路**：新增 `PushMemoShaderState` 机制，自动识别连续未命中的瞬态着色器并临时旁路查表，减少无效哈希计算。
- **屏障与状态查询精简**：收窄 `texel` 与 `compute_barrier()` 管线屏障，合并 `pending_view()` 单趟重叠检查，缓存 `VkFormatProperties3` 并跳过只读纹理的重复 `prepare_read`。
- **洞窟场景闪烁修复**：修复洞窟路段左右移动时偶发的右半屏隔帧闪烁问题，保持全场景画面完整稳定输出。

### 2. 完整内置功能
- **画质与帧率设置**（顶部菜单 `≡` → **画质与帧率**）：
  - **帧率上限**：支持 `沿用原设置 / 30 FPS / 40 FPS / 60 FPS`，调节后实时生效，无需重启。
  - **画面输出档位**：支持 `沿用原设置 / 720p 输出 / 1080p 输出`，保存并重开游戏后生效。
- **内置中文金手指**（顶部菜单 `≡` → **金手指**，勾选保存并重启生效）：
  - 移动速度 2 倍
  - 不遇敌（按住 R3 临时恢复正常）
  - 战斗掉落率 100%
  - 战斗经验值 2 倍
  - 战斗金币 2 倍
  - 角色存档修改

### 3. 虚拟手柄默认布局优化
- 缩小肩键（`L1/L2/R1/R2`）与功能键（`- / +`）尺寸，将肩键下移至左右中侧边缘，避免遮挡左上角帧率/任务信息与右上角小地图。
- 对称对齐左右摇杆、`L3/R3`、十字键与 `A/B/X/Y` 菱形按键间距，默认布局更紧凑清晰（仍支持在「编辑按键布局」中自由微调或重置）。

---

## 安装与使用提示
- 请确保设备存储根目录已放置合法导出的游戏数据目录 `/sdcard/FFRS`。

releases.body:
# Let's Go Launcher 0.3

This is the third release of Let's Go Launcher. It brings the game from barely playable on Mali to a real frame rate on weak devices, and fixes the boot failure that stopped the game from opening on some phones.

## Measured performance (Galaxy S20+, Mali-G77, heavy scene)

- **~13.6 fps → 16–20 fps, average ~17.6, peak 20.1** (measured over a 73-second session in the heavy scene; the previous build averaged ~13.6 fps there)
- The game is now GPU-bound (~96% GPU busy, ~23% CPU) — the CPU is no longer the wall
- With a warm pipeline cache, indoor battles reached 23–26 fps
- No crashes in the test session

## What's new in 0.3

releases.body:
Changes since the latest beta release:
- Fixed two UI issues (#843, #846)
- Fixed a bug in the CBM file system implementation (#853)
- Fixed a bug in the drive idle logic (#854)
- Fixed three drive-related VICE tests (#668, #674, #675)

Core and API

* Public API: The API now has as new shape. There are async counterparts (…Async) for state-changing calls, set is now setAsync, there is a new MemoryDebugger API, more getters, and suspend/resume coverage across the API.
* Threading: The command queue and message queue are now std::deque-based. Messages can carry exceptions. AudioPort is thread-safe. Cmd::CALL, TRACK_ON and TRACK_OFF are new.
* Messages: Msg::CONFIG is sent for every option change. ROM_LOADED, RSH_DONE and CONFIG_ERROR are new.
* RetroShell: It has the new architecture from vAmiga, with multiple shells and a single console per shell.
* Workspaces: A screenshot is now saved inside saveWorkspace().
* X-Ray: GPU X-Ray support is added, with a new XRAY_COMPOSITOR option.
* Shared libraries: utlib and rvlib were merged with the versions shared with vAmiga and Silicium.
* Cleanup: Header, include and namespace cleanups, plus removal of orphaned files.

Fixes

* Drive::isIdle() is fixed (#854).

This maintenance release primarily addresses issue #851, which prevented the app from running on the upcoming macOS 27 Golden Gate. It also includes internal code changes required to make the core compatible with the architecture of the upcoming Silicium emulator.
Removing beta status, as no significant bugs have been reported for some time.

## Refactoring

This beta release introduces substantial changes to the underlying code base. As part of the development of the RetroVault app, a new **RetroVault** library has been created. This library is now responsible for managing:

- File systems  
- Devices  
- All supported image formats  

RetroVault is designed as a standalone library and is also used in the latest version of vAmiga for the same purpose.

In addition, the new **utlib** library has been introduced. All utility functions previously embedded in vAmiga and VirtualC64 have been refactored into this more powerful shared library. This makes it easier for me to share common functionality among the different emulators. 

## Enhancements

- The disassembler now supports symbol files (#837)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a crash in the file system importer when importing excessively large folders (#841)  
- Fixed a bug in the VIC inspector that prevented selecting individual sprites in Tahoe (#840)

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.1.0 (beta)
releases.body:
CapyPS5 0.1.0 is the **first beta**: faster on every game, fewer crashes, and on-screen controls you can lay out yourself. PS4 backward compatibility stays experimental. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**Faster**
- **The GPU thread runs on the fastest CPU cores.** On a Snapdragon 8 Elite this alone made a demanding Unreal Engine 4 level about a third faster.
- **Less waiting for the GPU.** Several cases where the emulator stopped to read back data the GPU had just written are gone:
  - fast-clear metadata fills now run on the CPU;
  - GPU-driven draws of PS4 games are executed on the GPU;
  - fresh buffer data is copied without a system call per page.
  The same level gained about 30 % more on top.
- **Cheaper per-draw work:** shader resource tables are read in one go per table on ARM, which halved the cost of preparing each draw.

**More stable**
- Unreal Engine games that closed with a corrupt memory error a few seconds into a level (the game's own allocator reporting a broken "canary", or a crash reading address 1) no longer do: the emulator stopped waiting for a GPU signal that was only late.

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.5
releases.body:
Fifth alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. Mali GPUs on their system driver can now run games, and the FPS counter shows how many frames CapyPS5 Framegen adds. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**New**
- **Mali on the system driver:** that driver cannot sample BCn compressed textures, so the GPU used to be rejected. CapyPS5 now decompresses those textures on the GPU when it uploads them (BC1 to BC7, including BC6H HDR textures). GPUs that support BCn keep using it directly.
- **PanVK on Mali:** the GPU is no longer rejected when the driver lacks vertex-stage stores or dual-source blending.
- **Framegen counter:** with CapyPS5 Framegen on, the FPS counter reads *XX FPS - YY FG*: XX are the game's own frames, YY the total including generated ones. The options are now called *Framegen x2*, *x3* and *x4*.
- **HDR10 output:** games that output HDR10 are converted to SDR for the screen.

**Fixed**
- Tessellation: quad domains, fractional-even spacing, counterclockwise output and masked hull control points.

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.4

Fourth alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. More than 100 games now run correctly according to testers' reports, and this release adds CapyPS5 Framegen. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**New**
- **CapyPS5 Framegen:** optional frame generation. It draws in-between frames from the motion between two game frames, so a game at 30 FPS is shown at 60. Off by default; turn it on in *Settings → Performance* (1 per frame, or up to 3). Adds one frame of latency and some GPU load; works best from 25 FPS up.

releases.name: Castlevania port v0.5.0
releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for [issue 39](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/39): on a phone with an Exynos 2400, the Android app shows the same graphics message at every start once Anti-Aliasing is set to 8x. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is the code that will become 1.1.8, as it stands today. When the phone cannot make a picture buffer at the settings chosen, the port lowers a setting and asks for a restart. 1.1.7 only ever lowered Super Sampling, so with Super Sampling already at 1x nothing changed and every start ended the same way. This build lowers one setting each time: Super Sampling, then Anti-Aliasing, then Color Depth, then Render Scale. It never asks for an Anti-Aliasing level the phone does not offer, it remembers a level that failed, and the log names the levels the phone offers.

Install it over 1.1.7. Saves stay. If 1.1.7 left the phone stuck, the first start of this build should lower Anti-Aliasing to 4x by itself and get into the game. If it still stops, attach `snap64.log` from Internal storage > Snap64 to issue 39.

releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is [1.1.7-test3](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7-test3) with a fix for the crash that build recorded. The Thor's graphics driver crashed at the end of the first drawing pass of the first frame. That pass held a reset of the renderer's timers, which Vulkan does not allow inside a drawing pass. The port's own clear of new picture buffers had left the pass open. Now the reset, and the two other steps Vulkan keeps outside a drawing pass, close an open pass first. The log says so once.

The crash record from test3 stays in. If the app still closes, open it once more, then attach `snap64.log` to issue 36. Saves stay.

**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

# Lichii-Enhanced v1.0.0: first public release

Lichii-Enhanced is a fork of [Lichii](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii) focused on usability: easier setup, built-in upscaling, non-destructive modding and more reliable online play. This is the first public release.

> **Platform:** Windows 10/11 x64 only. Distributed as a `.zip` archive. Other platforms are not available yet.

## Highlights

### 🖼️ Built-in upscalers
Upscaling is now part of the renderer; no external injectors or wrappers are needed.

- New post-process stage at the end of the Vulkan frame (compute shaders), running after game rendering and before swapchain presentation
- Filters: Nearest, Bilinear, Bicubic, FSR 1.0 (EASU + RCAS), SGSR
- Configurable render scale and sharpness (RCAS strength)
- Per-game profiles stored in `config/custom/<title-id>.ini`
- Optional anti-aliasing pass before upscaling

releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.1 — your settings stay put

A patch release. No new features: **23 defects** found and fixed across five rounds of multi-agent bug hunting, plus a hardware-validation pass on the published packages.

### Settings are saved again

On macOS and on every AppImage, NeoST runs from **read-only media**, so it stores its configuration in your user directory — but it never created that directory, and every setting was silently lost when you closed the emulator. **Five of the eight packages were affected.** Machine profile, video, audio and MIDI setup now survive a restart.

### Also fixed

- **The macOS disk image installs by drag and drop.** It shipped with the app alone, no `Applications` shortcut.
- **The web build ships its licences** (GPL-3.0, GPL-2.0, third-party notices), like every other package.
- **A save-state can no longer be reloaded under a different ROM.** The pairing relied on two bytes of TOS version, which five localisations share, so resuming under the wrong ROM froze the CPU without a word. The state format is now **v19**; v18 and older are refused explicitly, with a message that says why.

releases.name: hakuX 1.3.0
releases.body:
Xbox Live through Insignia, and game fixes.

### Xbox Live
- **Insignia** — Settings → Network → Connection → Xbox Live: Insignia connects the console to Insignia, the revival of the original Xbox Live: Live games sign in, find matches and play online. If your Internet provider blocks Insignia's DNS server, point it at a computer running insigniaDNS instead
- **Xbox Live setup** — Settings → Network → Xbox Live setup walks you through it, one step at a time: the connection, the Xbox dashboard, registering the console with Insignia's Setup Assistant (downloaded for you), then making or recovering your account in the dashboard
- **Dashboard** — the library's Dashboard button (top left) starts the Xbox dashboard from the console's hard disk, where Xbox Live accounts are made and recovered. The first time, it installs the dashboard from a zip of its files (dashboard 5960) that you provide: hakuX doesn't include one
- **Title updates** — a game's Xbox Live update, once downloaded, starts with the game. Forza Motorsport's 60 and 120 fps mods cover its update too

### Games
- **Fable: The Lost Chapters** — the hero's face and arms are no longer black or noise

releases.name: hakuX 1.2.0
releases.body:
System link, stability and compatibility improvements.

### Network
- **System link over your network** — Settings → Network → System link → LAN: hakuX devices on the same Wi-Fi network find each other as Xbox consoles on a LAN do. Devices the network's broadcasts don't reach, on another subnet or a VPN such as ZeroTier or Tailscale, are added by address under Other consoles
- **XLink Kai** — system link over the Internet through an XLink Kai engine running on a computer on your network; its web page picks the game's arena
- **Console identity** — each console has its own serial number, network address and online key. A device whose hard disk was copied from another one offers to make itself a new identity, since two consoles with one identity can't see each other


### Games
- **Sega GT 2002** — the cars have their paint, reflections and sun highlights
- **Doom 3** — no longer crashes as its main menu loads
- **Fatal Frame II** — starts and reads its disc in the order it asks for
- **AirForce Delta Storm** — answers the controller and the on-screen controls (it ignored all input)
- **Silent Hill 2** — no longer crashes when it loads a room

releases.name: hakuX 1.1.0
releases.body:
GPUs beyond Adreno (experimental).

### GPUs
- **Mali, Xclipse and PowerVR (experimental)** — hakuX runs on GPUs other than Adreno: features they lack are replaced (BC and 4444 textures decoded up front, standard border colours, the push block in a buffer, D32S8 depth), and known driver bugs are worked around (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`). Burnout 3 and Mercenaries run cleanly on a Pixel 8 (Mali-G715)
- **Vulkan 1.1 drivers** — GPUs whose drivers stop at Vulkan 1.1 (Valhall Mali on older or vendor-capped drivers, Qualcomm's own older drivers, early Xclipse, PowerVR BXM) run through a compatibility layer (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/compat.c`)
- **Older GPUs without descriptor indexing (experimental)** — Bifrost Mali (G71, G72, G76, G52) and PowerVR Rogue: each draw binds its own textures, and depth is clamped in the shader where the GPU can't
- **Adreno** — unchanged: every replacement is off where the GPU has the feature.

### App
- **GPU driver** — a screen of its own (Settings → GPU driver): the system driver and the stored packages in one list, with their versions and authors. Packages are checked when added and can be deleted (deleting the one in use goes back to the system driver)

releases.name: hakuX 1.0.0
releases.body:
A new core replaces xemu's QEMU-based one.

### New core
- **CPU** — the Xbox's x86 code runs on a FEX JIT (FEXCore fork), and the Xbox kernel is reimplemented natively (`native/kernel`): no QEMU
- **GPU** — the NV2A push buffer is decoded into Vulkan (HLE, `hw/xbox/hle`). Custom drivers (Turnip) load through adrenotools; driver-specific workarounds are quirks (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`, `debug.hakux.quirks`)
- **Audio** — the MCPX APU runs on the core's own services (`native/dev/apu`), out through AAudio
- **Savestates** — per game, in slots, with the hard disk's files
- **Mods and cheats** — per game, from `mods/` (library long-press "Mods & cheats"): XBE patches and replaced disc files; 60 and 120 fps mods for 13 games (`mods/README.md`, generators in `tools/mods`)
- **Controllers** — each physical controller routed to a player with its own mapping; the on-screen controller adds to player 1

### New features
- **Updates** — hakuX looks for a newer release on GitHub when it starts and on demand (Settings → Updates); one found shows its notes and installs from there
- **Frontends** — a game launched from ES-DE or another frontend returns to it when it closes

releases.body:
# SeedlessDS 1.1 正式版

版本名为 `1.1`，版本号为 `153`。本次同时发布原包名替换版、共存版、对应源码及 SHA-256 校验文件。两版均关闭 Android 调试标志，正式版本号与发布文件名均不含 debug，测试控制面板关闭。

## 本次改进

- 修复后台存档提前完成时，完成状态被模拟线程覆盖，导致后续快速存档和读档一直被忽略的问题。
- 减少存读档结束后的多余槽位查询、成就附加档读取和目录扫描，成就校验改为流式 SHA-256。
- 拆分即时存档、游戏电池存档和其它文件的访问锁，避免后台慢存档连带阻塞游戏文件读取。后台存档线程降低优先级。
- 防止并发慢查询重新发布已失效的目录列表，修复日志时间格式化的并发访问。
- 在应用私有目录保留有大小上限的近期存读档记录，便于追查偶发卡顿。
- 保留 SoundTouch 原声音高加速、低延迟音频恢复修复，以及按 RP Duo 上下屏实际画面尺寸适配的柔和颗粒、柔和颗粒＋和 Nova 磷光点滤镜。

## 安装包选择

| 文件 | Android 包名 | 安装方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `seedless-ds-1.1-coexist.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app.debug` | 可直接更新本分支旧共存版，也可与官方版共存 |
| `seedless-ds-1.1-replacement.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app` | 原包名替换版 |
| `seedless-ds-fork-1.1-src.zip` | — | 两版对应的完整源码与构建配置 |
| `seedless-ds-1.1-SHA256.txt` | — | 安装包和源码校验值 |

共存版按用户选择保留历史包名中的 `.debug`，以支持覆盖更新，应用本身已关闭调试。两版均沿用本分支旧签名。

替换版与官方版签名不同。首次换用替换版，请先导出存档与配置，再卸载官方版并安装。直接覆盖官方版会因签名不匹配而失败。两个包名的数据各自独立，切换使用时需导入存档。

两版均支持 ARM64，最低 Android 5.0。证书 SHA-256 为 `99e2395bd7c458a577e6bc4f4c7237a7474cb20a178fad07313c2778a7943165`，沿用仓库随源公开测试签名。

## 验证范围

- 两种正式构建各 128 项应用测试通过，完成构建、Lint、包名和签名检查，并核对 `debuggable=false`、`testOnly=false` 及 `BuildConfig.DEBUG=false`。两版的应用资源和原生库一致。
- 原生回归覆盖 21 类存档故障、280 轮重复存读档及请求交错。

releases.body:
## Pacman suite (packaging revision 2)

Download **`termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz`** and its `.sha256` file. This is a real Pacman package:

```sh
sha256sum -c termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz.sha256
pacman -U ./termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz
```

It directly owns the native runtime and API commands and stages both APKs under `$PREFIX/share/termux-aether-suite`. Update Android apps using `aether-apks api`, then `aether-apks app`; Android confirms these updates. Existing app IDs, signatures and data paths are preserved. Shizuku and Arch images remain optional.

If you previously installed Aether commands manually, download `aether-install.py` and its checksum too:

```sh
sha256sum -c aether-install.py.sha256
python aether-install.py --adopt-legacy ./termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz
```

This backs up only the nine known unowned legacy commands and transfers ownership to Pacman. Unrelated files/packages are refused. No wildcard overwrite or editing of checksum-protected scripts is needed. Use `aether-update` for later protected upgrades, or install new suite packages with `pacman -U` directly.

releases.body:
# FusionHUD v1.0

**FusionHUD** is a lightweight, forkable in-game performance overlay for Android (Winlator / Wine / PC-emulation projects) — the MangoHud-inspired HUD extracted from [Bannerlator](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator) so any project can adopt it.

## What you get
- **The Fusion HUD** — one overlay, **5 tap-cyclable sizes** (Full / Tiles / Pill / Minimal / Mega) with toggleable per-metric chips.
- **A hardened, cross-vendor metric backend** — FPS + frametime graph, CPU (aggregate + per-core), GPU %/clock/temp, thermals, RAM/VRAM, battery (with the **mA/µA current-unit auto-detect** that fixes `0.0W` on OEMs like HONOR), and network — with graceful fallbacks across **Adreno · Mali · PowerVR · Xclipse**.
- **Diagnostics export** for triaging metric gaps on unusual devices.
- Composited ~1 Hz off the present path — designed not to cost frames.

## How to adopt it
- **Gradle (JitPack):** add JitPack and depend on `com.github.The412Banner:FusionHUD:v1.0` — or grab the **`fusionhud-release.aar`** attached below.

# Winlator 中文版 (Wine 11) v1.0.0

基于 [Winlator 11.1](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator) 深度定制:

## 主要变化
- **Wine 10.10 -> Wine 11.15**: 移植 brunodev85 全部定制补丁 (Android 存储符号链接、GPU 信息上报、X11 窗口属性等) 至 Wine 11.15 新 WoW64 模式 (x86_64-unix + i386/x86_64 双架构 PE)
- **esync -> fastsync**: 移除旧 esync 机制, 使用 Wine 11 原生 fastsync, 同步性能更好

  - Android 界面全面中文翻译 (values-zh-rCN)
  - 内置 Noto Sans CJK SC 中文字体 + fontconfig 中文别名

  - Wine 前缀注册表中文字体替换 (宋体/SimSun -> Noto Sans CJK SC)
  - 新建容器默认中文环境

## 下载安装
直接下载下方 APK (约 325 MB) 安装即可, 无需额外组件。首次启动会自动解包 rootfs。

- 构建配方见仓库 `wine/`、`chinese/`、`.github/workflows/build.yml`

If the stick is unplugged at that moment, nothing is dropped: the repair waits and retries (at most once a minute) until the stick is back.

    2. The app does not set the vkd3d-proton keys yet. In the game's environment add `VKD3D_CONFIG=dxr,dxr11,no_upload_hvv,single_queue,extra_rtas_sync` (the app's default for The Witcher 3 is `nodxr`, so this key replaces it).
